title: Ferdi Kadıoğlu Totem Pack
description: Survive with Ferdi! Replaces the Totem of Undying with Ferdi Kadıoğlu and adds the iconic "Çok Mutluyuz" sound.
body:
Bring a fresh football vibe to your Minecraft world with the Ferdi Totem Resource Pack!

This resource pack replaces the default Totem of Undying with Ferdi Kadıoğlu, giving your gameplay a unique and fun appearance. In addition, the original Totem activation sound has been replaced with the iconic "Çok Mutluyuz" chant, perfectly mixed with the activation sound effect for a more immersive experience.

Designed for PvP and Survival players who want a clean, lightweight resource pack without sacrificing performance.


⭐Features
- Replaces the default Totem of Undying with Ferdi Kadıoğlu.
- Custom "Çok Mutluyuz" sound plays when the Totem activates.
- Original activation effect mixed with the custom sound for a better experience.
- Lightweight and optimized for high FPS.
- Perfect for PvP, Survival and Multiplayer.
- No OptiFine or additional mods required.
- Compatible with Minecraft 1.16+ (including the latest versions).


📌 Compatibility

✔ Minecraft Java Edition

✔ Works on modern Minecraft versions.

✔ Multiplayer compatible.



Enjoy surviving with Ferdi by your side!
